title: Whedon Three Way #1 Dark Horse 2014 Buffy Serenity Angel Faith Georges Jeanty
condition_description: Bright cover with light handling wear; small chip on the back cover. See photos.
description:
The Whedon Three Way (September 10, 2014), Dark Horse Comics - three #1 issues in one 72-page $1 special: Buffy the Vampire Slayer Season 10 #1, Angel & Faith Season 10 #1 and Serenity: Leaves on the Wind #1. Executive producer Joss Whedon; Zack Whedon, Christos Gage, Victor Gischler, Georges Jeanty, Rebekah Isaacs and Will Conrad. Cover by Georges Jeanty.

Back cover: Dark Horse Builds Characters Hellboy ad (Mike Mignola).

Condition: bright with light handling wear; small chip on the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
